title: Nikola Jokić, Anthony Edwards team up for new global platform
summary: Sprite, the official global soft drink of the NBA, has unveiled a new platform "Never Stop Refreshing the Game," featuring three-time NBA MVP Nikola Jokić and All-Star guard Anthony Edwards.
